luau.release_note: The 2019 team recap records the new Luau implementation already deployed; open-source publication followed in 2021.
luau.note: Gradual types with a separate optional static checker and dynamic runtime checks. Standard Luau incremental tracing GC. All authored embedding and native-library binding source is counted; native benchmark algorithms are absent from the host.
luau.runtime_policy: Luau 0.743 at 9d7748a4f324213a18cb8283fa2a77c330225fa0, source -O2 and type info level 1, one process/one VM; runtime build excluded, per-process source compilation included.
luau.memory_policy: Standard Luau incremental tracing collector, default configuration; GMP/PCRE2 allocations belong to the declared foreign libraries.
luau.evidence_scope: Pinned official source, retained runtime build and executable hashes, exact measured commands and output checks; no claim of execution in Roblox or of native AOT compilation.
luau.label: Luau (interpreted)
